title: BingX Wealth officially launches
description: BingX announced that BingX Wealth was officially live with flexible-term and fixed-term yield products.
notes: This is the verified launch date of the Wealth predecessor to the current BingX Earn product family.

title: BingX launches Wealth as Margin
description: BingX launched a feature allowing subscribed USDT Wealth assets to be used as perpetual-futures margin while continuing to accrue Wealth interest unless liquidation occurs.
notes: This event affects risk and liquidity mechanics for users who opt to use Wealth assets as futures margin; it is not treated as the rename date to Earn.

title: MEXC Flexible Savings hourly interest rules take effect
description: MEXC changed Flexible Savings interest calculation from daily to hourly accrual, effective 4 February 2026.
notes: This is a documented product-mechanics update, not the original launch date.

title: MEXC publishes current Earn Service Agreement
description: MEXC published the reviewed Earn Service Agreement governing Flexible and Fixed Savings and explicitly describing principal-loss, asset-use, APR and redemption risks.
notes: The agreement is used for current risk and custody interpretation; it does not establish the original Savings launch date.
